summary: Calhoun County lookout listed as removed; a federal survey station at the site was first observed in 1967, with little else on record.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey first observed the survey station; datasheet codes the marker as a lookout tower

evidence.quote: Banner is an unincorporated community in Calhoun County, Mississippi
Banner is located along Mississippi Highway 9W

evidence.supports: station first observed by the Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1967

sources.title: NGS Data Sheet, PID EG1739 (Banner Fire Tower)

notes_for_editor: Only the lookouts list (removed) and the NGS datasheet say anything about this site. The datasheet has no station description and no recovery note, so the removal date, what remains, and the staffing and design are all unknown. Record point 34.11846, -89.38495 lies about 8 m from the NGS station (34 07 06.72 N, 89 23 06.05 W), so the point and the station are probably the same site, but the datasheet does not say where the tower stood relative to the station. Two web searches found no staffing or build records for Banner.
